reviews.title: Careful!
reviews.text: It gave me a 3 day free trial option. I activated it and canceled the subscription so I wouldn’t forget and get charged. As soon as I unsubscribed they charged me 60 dollars. At first I thought it was a fluke so I went through apples claim process to dispute it and was able to get my money back. A month or so later I got the 3 day trial again and thought I’d try again (silly me). I activate for and unsubscribed again and what do you know, it charged me immediately. I tried to dispute it and it got denied. Careful with this app!

reviews.title: Wouldn’t recommend for social media management.
reviews.text:
I found that if you adjust your profile grid cover on posts/reels it doesn’t update in the app. 
Some posts also just don’t show up on the app grid no matter how many times you refresh. 
Because of this, it’s not a reliable platform for social media management / general planning. 
If they fixed these issues I would be happy to use this app for my work as I do enjoy their formatting. 
I appreciate the fact that you don’t have to log in to your instagram account to use this app.

I must have reached my limit of free uploads until Jan 1st, so it prompted me to pay for the subscription or to continue with the 3-day free trial, $49.99 automatically renewed. It claimed ‘no payment now’ so I continued with it and IT CHARGED ME immediately full annual price. I’m very upset and cancelled the subscription immediately hoping to dispute the charge.

reviews.title: Very misleading app.
reviews.text:
The scheduling is just a case of this app sending you a notification reminding you to post something. That’s it. There is no automation at all. Even the captions have to be copy pasted from this app to Instagram. 

It look pretty, but it’s an expensive tool that doesn’t really do much.
